svg.desc: A client call is classified: success returns, rate-limit, gateway, timeout and connection errors back off exponentially and retry up to three times, and client errors such as 422 are raised at once.

svg.text: Waits: 0.2 s, 0.4 s, 0.8 s. A 500 is usually a bug: retry at most once.
